Kernels only exist when the build sets CEDAR_SIMD\n// (the `simd` / `wasm-simd` presets); default builds compile to the scalar\n// bodies exactly as before.\n//\n//   x86-64 (GCC/Clang): kernels carry CEDAR_TARGET_AVX2, so no TU needs\n//     -mavx2; the ISA is detected once at static init. SSE2 is baseline.\n//   aarch64: NEON is baseline — CEDAR_SIMD_NEON kernels need no dispatch.\n//   WASM:    SIMD128 when built with -msimd128 (CEDAR_SIMD_WASM).\n//\n// Kernels must not allocate, lock or syscall (the [zero_alloc] trap enforces),\n// and may assume 32-byte aligned buffers (BufferPool slabs are alignas(32)) —\n// assert it with CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED.\n\n#include <cassert>\n#include <cstdint>\n\n#if defined(CEDAR_SIMD) && (defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)) && \\\n    (defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__))\n#  define CEDAR_SIMD_X86 1\n#  include <immintrin.h>\n#  define CEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::target(\"avx2\")]]\n#else\n#  define CEDAR_SIMD_X86 0\n#endif\n\n#if defined(CEDAR_SIMD) && (defined(__ARM_NEON) || defined(__ARM_NEON__))\n#  define CEDAR_SIMD_NEON 1\n#  include <arm_neon.h>\n#else\n#  define CEDAR_SIMD_NEON 0\n#endif\n\n#if defined(CEDAR_SIMD) && defined(__wasm_simd128__)\n#  define CEDAR_SIMD_WASM 1\n#  include <wasm_simd128.h>\n#else\n#  define CEDAR_SIMD_WASM 0\n#endif\n\n#define CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(p, n) \\\n    assert((reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(p) % (n)) == 0 && \"SIMD kernel: misaligned buffer\")\n\nnamespace cedar::simd {\n\nenum class Isa : std::uint8_t { Scalar, Sse2, Avx2, Neon, Wasm128 };\n\nnamespace detail {\n// Written once during static initialisation (src/dsp/simd.cpp); read-only after.\nextern Isa g_active;\n}\n\n// Best ISA available on this CPU *and* compiled into this build.\n[[nodiscard]] inline Isa active() noexcept { return detail::g_active; }\n\n// True when kernels for `isa` may run. x86 levels nest (Avx2 implies Sse2).\n[[nodiscard]] inline bool has(Isa isa) noexcept {\n    const Isa a = detail::g_active;\n    if (isa == Isa::Scalar) return true;\n    if (isa == Isa::Sse2) return a == Isa::Sse2 || a == Isa::Avx2;\n    return a == isa;\n}\n\n[[nodiscard]] const char* name(Isa isa) noexcept;\n\n// Test/bench hook: force a lower ISA (e.g. Scalar) to A/B the fallback path.\n// Not for use while audio is running.\nvoid force(Isa isa) noexcept;\n\n}  // namespace cedar::simd\n","numLines":75,"startLine":1,"totalLines":75}}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfQbmgbu1VDw4BFm9a1fJ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"`op_distort_tanh` is about 7% faster in the short benchmark (38.5 → 36.03 ns/block). `op_distort_soft` is unchanged (39.62 → 39.67 ns/block, 1.00x).\n\n**The change** (in `cedar/include/cedar/opcodes/distortion.hpp`): the tanh approximation now works on the signed input as `tanh(y) = 1 - 2/(1 + e^(2y))`. Before, it split off the sign, worked on `|y|` and put the sign back at the end. Clamping the exponent argument to [-120, 120] on both sides makes the sign split unnecessary, which saves 2 of about 21 FP-port operations per 8 samples. The clamp is ordered so that NaN still passes through. The `// simd: approx tanh` comment is updated, and the scalar body is untouched.\n\n**Check results (2 of 10 runs used):**\n- The allowlist, the build and the equality check on the fixed stimuli passed.\n- The approximation error against the scalar output is -114.9 dBFS, inside the -100 dBFS limit.\n- The hidden stimuli, unit test suites and the longer benchmark only run at the final verification, so those are still unconfirmed.\n\n**Why soft is unchanged:** it must stay bit-exact, and it is limited by its two `vdivps` divisions (x/t and the rational). I rejected two replacements:\n- **Reciprocal plus FMA refinement:** it needs FMA, which isn't enabled. I also couldn't prove it always gives exactly the same result, especially for denormals, ±0 and infinity.\n- **Replacing the blends with min/max:** that isn't bit-exact near |u| = 3 or for u = inf.\n\nIDEA: tanh approx bound on ~21 FP-port ops per 8 samples (abs/sign split, one-sided clamp, sign xor) -> evaluate 1-2/(1+e^(2y)) on signed y with a two-sided ±120 clamp, removing and/andnot/xor (check: bit-exact/approx OK at -114.9 dBFS, distort_tanh 38.5->36.03 ns 1.07x, distort_soft 1.00x)"}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":319,"cache_read_input_tokens":52087,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":319},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"018aa9dc-ec7e-4bc2-b500-14e3313926b7","uuid":"8d3084b0-e230-4134-aa04-102b0f6d1a7c","timestamp":"2026-09-25T18:05:10.571Z","request_id":"req_011CfQbmg4QQRnG6Ay2bpiso"}
